Chitosan.description: Linear beta-(1->4)-linked D-glucosamine / N-acetyl-D-glucosamine copolymer. Repeat unit shown is the deacetylated glucosamine unit.
Chitosan.note: Real material is a copolymer of glucosamine and N-acetylglucosamine. For a more faithful representation, model ~85% glucosamine + ~15% N-acetylglucosamine units. N-acetyl unit P-SMILES: [*]OC1C(NC(C)=O)C(O[*])OC(CO)C1O

Bacillus subtilis EPS.description: Exopolysaccharide from Bacillus subtilis EA5 (GenBank OR501464). FTIR confirms hydroxyl, amino, methylene, carbonyl, and phosphate groups, but no defined monosaccharide composition or linkage structure is reported in the source paper.
Bacillus subtilis EPS.note: No canonical P-SMILES available. Monosaccharide composition would need to be sourced from ref 26 (Bashandy et al. 2024, Curr. Microbiol. 81:408). Structurally undefined.

Chitosan/EPS composite.description: Physical blend of chitosan and Bacillus subtilis EPS (no covalent cross-linker; chitosan in 1% acetic acid mixed with EPS, heated to 70 C). Two-component material with no single repeat unit.
Chitosan/EPS composite.note: Composite/blend - represent as its two components (chitosan + EPS) rather than a single P-SMILES.

BC aerogel.description: Bacterial cellulose (from pineapple peel waste via Acetobacter xylinum fermentation). Pure cellulose: linear beta-(1->4)-linked D-glucose polymer, free of lignin and hemicellulose. High crystallinity (>80%).
BC aerogel.note: Same backbone as plant cellulose; cellobiose is the true crystallographic repeat. Glucose-unit P-SMILES shown.

Cellulose citrate.description: Microcrystalline cellulose esterified with citric acid. Cellulose glucose-unit backbone bearing a citrate ester substituent (one of the citric acid carboxyls forms the ester; the remaining two carboxylic acids are free and provide the cationic-dye binding sites).
Cellulose citrate.degree_of_substitution: 0.46 citrate groups per glucose unit (from Methods; abstract states avg ~2 citrate groups per glucose unit - figures conflict, DS=0.46 is the measured titration value)
Cellulose citrate.note: P-SMILES shown is the fully-substituted glucose unit (one citrate ester per glucose). Real material is a partial ester (DS 0.46), so most glucose units are unsubstituted cellulose. Model as a copolymer of substituted + unsubstituted units for fidelity. Free-acid form shown; deprotonates to carboxylate above pH ~6.

Fe3O4@MOF-PAMAM/cellulose acetate.description: Four-component electrospun composite: cellulose acetate nanofiber support + Zr-MOF (UiO-66, from ZrCl4 + terephthalic acid) + Fe3O4 magnetite core + third-generation PAMAM dendrimer (G3) surface functionalization.
Fe3O4@MOF-PAMAM/cellulose acetate.note: No single P-SMILES. Composite of one linear polymer (cellulose acetate), one crystalline MOF (UiO-66, framework - not a P-SMILES target), one inorganic nanoparticle (Fe3O4), and one hyperbranched dendrimer (PAMAM-G3, also not a linear repeat unit). Represent by components.

cellulose acetate.note: Cellulose acetate; glucose-unit backbone with acetyl esters on the hydroxyls. Degree of acetylation varies by grade; fully-acetylated unit shown.

UiO-66 (Zr-MOF).note: Zr6O4(OH)4 nodes bridged by 1,4-benzenedicarboxylate (terephthalate) linkers. 3D framework - no SMILES. Linker = terephthalic acid: OC(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)cc1

Fe3O4.note: Magnetite nanoparticle core. Inorganic, no SMILES.

PAMAM-G3.note: Third-generation poly(amidoamine) dendrimer (hyperbranched, ethylenediamine core, amidoamine branches, terminal -NH2 groups). Not a linear repeat unit; no single P-SMILES. Branch motif: NCCC(=O)NCCN

Coconut husk cellulose.description: Cellulose extracted from coconut husk (Cocos nucifera) agricultural waste via NaOH alkali pretreatment + sodium hypochlorite bleaching, which removes lignin and hemicellulose. Linear beta-(1->4)-linked D-glucose polymer.
Coconut husk cellulose.note: Pure cellulose backbone, same glucose-unit P-SMILES as other unmodified celluloses (bacterial cellulose). No chemical functionalization.

poly(MAA-co-AAm) hydrogel.description: Poly(methacrylic acid-co-acrylamide) crosslinked hydrogel. Free-radical copolymer of methacrylic acid (MAA) and acrylamide (AAm), crosslinked with N,N'-methylenebisacrylamide. Synthesized at MAA:AAm monomer ratio of 2:1 (optimal); reactivity ratios r(MAA)=1.94, r(AAm)=0.30 give a random copolymer.
poly(MAA-co-AAm) hydrogel.note: P-SMILES shows one MAA unit + one AAm unit as a representative 1:1 repeat; real material is a random copolymer at ~2:1 MAA:AAm with bisacrylamide crosslinks (not shown). MAA carboxyl deprotonates above pH ~5, giving the anionic sites that bind cationic MB. Crosslinker fragment: C(=O)NCNC(=O).

poly(MAA-co-AAm)/NCC hydrogel.description: Nanocomposite hydrogel: poly(MAA-co-AAm) copolymer matrix with 10 wt% Cloisite 30B nanoclay (organo-modified montmorillonite) exfoliated between polymer chains. XRD shows loss of the clay 001 peak, indicating exfoliation.
poly(MAA-co-AAm)/NCC hydrogel.note: Composite/blend - no single P-SMILES. Represent as its two components: the poly(MAA-co-AAm) copolymer (see its entry) + Cloisite 30B nanoclay. Cloisite 30B = montmorillonite (layered aluminosilicate, inorganic - no SMILES) surface-modified with a quaternary ammonium salt (methyl tallow bis-2-hydroxyethyl ammonium). Quat modifier fragment SMILES: [N+](C)(CCO)(CCO)C.

PANI.description: Polyaniline (emeraldine). Conducting polymer of aniline; repeat shown is the reduced (leucoemeraldine) amine unit. Real material alternates amine and imine units depending on oxidation/doping state.
PANI.note: Emeraldine base P-SMILES (amine unit). Imine (quinoid) unit: [*]N=C1C=CC(=[*])C=C1. -NH- groups protonate under acid (doping), giving the cationic sites that bind anionic dyes.

Polypyrrole.description: Polypyrrole. Conducting polymer of pyrrole, alpha-alpha' linked. The protonatable N-H backbone binds anionic dyes via electrostatic + pi-pi interactions.
Polypyrrole.note: Neutral (undoped) repeat unit shown. Doped/oxidized form carries delocalized positive charge with counter-anions.

PANI nanofibers.description: Polyaniline in nanofiber morphology (50-80 nm diameter). Same chemistry as bulk PANI; high surface area improves dye uptake.
PANI nanofibers.note: Same P-SMILES as PANI emeraldine amine unit; difference is morphology, not chemistry.

PANI powder.description: Crosslinked polyaniline powder (sponge-like, porous). Same backbone as PANI.
PANI powder.note: Same PANI emeraldine repeat; crosslinked variant. Crosslinker not specified in review.

PANI hollow nanotubes.description: Polyaniline hollow nanotubes (inner dia 50-60 nm). Same PANI chemistry, tubular morphology.

PANI-HNTs.description: Polyaniline-halloysite nanotube composite. PANI deposited on halloysite (Al2Si2O5(OH)4 aluminosilicate nanotubes).
PANI-HNTs.note: Composite. Components: PANI (see entry) + halloysite (inorganic aluminosilicate, no SMILES). NOTE: distinct from 'PANI hollow nanotubes' which are pure PANI.

Polyvinyl alcohol.description: Poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA). Linear polymer with pendant hydroxyl on every other carbon; H-bonding hydroxyls drive dye binding.
Polyvinyl alcohol.note: Idealized fully-hydrolyzed repeat unit; commercial PVA often partially acetylated.

Starch/polyaniline.description: Starch/polyaniline composite. Blend of amylose/amylopectin starch with conducting PANI.
Starch/polyaniline.note: Composite. Components: starch (alpha-glucan; glucose unit P-SMILES [*]OC1OC(CO)C(O)C(O)C1[*]) + PANI (see entry).

Cellulose nanocrystal-reinforced keratin.description: Keratin protein reinforced with cellulose nanocrystals (CNC). Two-biopolymer composite: keratin (protein) + crystalline cellulose.
Cellulose nanocrystal-reinforced keratin.note: Composite. Cellulose unit P-SMILES: [*]OC1OC(CO)C(O[*])C(O)C1O. Keratin = protein (no single repeat); rich in cysteine/charged residues that bind dyes.

Cellulose-g-poly(acrylic acid-co-acrylam.description: Cellulose backbone graft-copolymerized with poly(acrylic acid-co-acrylamide). Carboxylate + amide functional graft chains provide high-capacity dye binding.
Cellulose-g-poly(acrylic acid-co-acrylam.note: Graft copolymer. Cellulose backbone unit: [*]OC1OC(CO)C(O[*])C(O)C1O. Graft chain repeat (AA + AAm): [*]CC(C(=O)O)CC([*])C(N)=O. Carboxyls deprotonate above pH ~5.

Alpha-cellulose/magnetite/polypyrrole.description: Alpha-cellulose coated with Fe3O4 magnetite nanoparticles and conducting polypyrrole. Magnetic three-component composite.
Alpha-cellulose/magnetite/polypyrrole.note: Composite. Cellulose unit: [*]OC1OC(CO)C(O[*])C(O)C1O; polypyrrole unit: [*]c1ccc([*])[nH]1; Fe3O4 inorganic (no SMILES).

Polypyrrole-MWCNT.description: Polypyrrole composited with multi-walled carbon nanotubes.
Polypyrrole-MWCNT.note: Composite. Polypyrrole unit: [*]c1ccc([*])[nH]1; MWCNT = graphitic carbon nanotube (no molecular SMILES).

PANI/GO.note: Composite. PANI (see entry) + graphene oxide (oxidized graphene sheet; no single SMILES).

PANI/rGO.note: Composite. PANI (see entry) + reduced graphene oxide (no single SMILES).

PANI-modified rice husk composite.description: Rice husk (lignocellulosic biomass) modified with polyaniline coating.
PANI-modified rice husk composite.note: Composite. PANI (see entry) + rice husk (lignocellulose + silica; heterogeneous biomass, no single SMILES).

PANI/Fe3O4.note: Composite. PANI (see entry) + Fe3O4 (inorganic magnetite, no SMILES).

PANI/TiO2.note: Composite. PANI (see entry) + TiO2 (inorganic, no SMILES).

Chitosan/PANI/ZnO.description: Chitosan / polyaniline / zinc oxide ternary composite.
Chitosan/PANI/ZnO.note: Composite. Chitosan (see entry) + PANI (see entry) + ZnO (inorganic, no SMILES).

Chitosan nanoparticles on fibrous carrie.description: Chitosan nanoparticles immobilized on a fibrous support carrier.
Chitosan nanoparticles on fibrous carrie.note: Chitosan (see Chitosan entry for P-SMILES) on an unspecified fibrous carrier. Treat adsorbent-active component as chitosan.

Chitosan-Fe(III) spinel ferrite composit.description: Chitosan crosslinked with glutaraldehyde, dispersed with 15% spinel ferrite. Magnetic chitosan composite.
Chitosan-Fe(III) spinel ferrite composit.note: Composite. Chitosan (see entry) + spinel ferrite (inorganic, no SMILES); glutaraldehyde crosslinks.

Fe2O3-chitosan-bamboo sawdust.description: Fe2O3 / chitosan / bamboo sawdust composite. Magnetic biocomposite.
Fe2O3-chitosan-bamboo sawdust.note: Composite. Chitosan (see entry) + bamboo sawdust (lignocellulose) + Fe2O3 (inorganic).

Chitosan-EDTA-magnetic graphene oxide.description: Chitosan functionalized with EDTA on magnetic graphene oxide.
Chitosan-EDTA-magnetic graphene oxide.note: Composite. Chitosan (see entry) + EDTA (HOOCCH2)2NCCN(CH2COOH)2 chelator + magnetic GO (Fe3O4 + graphene oxide).

Cross-linked chitosan/sepiolite clay.description: Chitosan crosslinked and composited with sepiolite clay (Mg-silicate).
Cross-linked chitosan/sepiolite clay.note: Composite. Chitosan (see entry) + sepiolite (Mg4Si6O15(OH)2; fibrous clay, no SMILES).
